install_tell: ollama run devstral  |  vllm serve mistralai/Devstral-Small-2505 --tool-call-parser mistral --enable-auto-tool-choice  |  vllm serve mistralai/Devstral-2-123B-Instruct-2512
misconfig_patterns: Devstral is a MODEL not a server; auth posture is inherited from the chosen serving stack (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio, SGLang)
Every Mistral-recommended serving stack is no-auth-default; following the official quickstart yields an unauth host
Ollama 11434: no-auth by design (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 the standard public-bind recipe)
vLLM 8000: --api-key covers ONLY /v1/* — non-/v1 endpoints (/invocations, /generative_scoring, /pooling, /classify, /score, /rerank) bypass auth
LM Studio 1234, SGLang 30000, text-gen-webui 5000/7860: no-auth default on OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Devstral fits on a single RTX 4090 / 32GB Mac, biasing the population toward solo-operator / lab deploys that skip reverse-proxy auth

active_probe.false_positive_check: Insight #15 ~50% rule — substring 'devstral' in raw HTML is FP-prone (proper noun, rare French given name). REQUIRE JSON-context match: hit MUST be inside a model-list JSON response (/v1/models id field, or /api/tags name/model field), NOT page title / HTML body / nginx welcome.

deployment_tells: Ollama 11434 + /api/tags listing devstral or devstral-2 = highest-yield single signal (956.5K + 234.8K Ollama Library pulls)
Devstral-2 (123B) requires multi-GPU (--tensor-parallel-size 8), so larger operators / cloud GPU tenants
Devstral-Small-2505 (24B) fits one RTX 4090 = high lab / personal / single-host density
OpenHands UI (port 3000) co-located with vLLM 8000 = Mistral-recommended agent scaffold
Tabby (port 8080) + Ollama 11434 on same host = self-hosted Copilot pattern; tabby config points at devstral
Continue.dev config.json on developer machines references model='devstral' or 'mistralai/Devstral-Small-2505' — surfaces in GitHub code-search
docker-compose.yml with image ollama/ollama AND env OLLAMA_MODELS containing devstral
TLS cert CN often matches OpenHands / Tabby / personal-domain pattern rather than corporate cert
pivot_paths: GET /api/tags (Ollama) -> full model inventory; if devstral present, ALSO see what else is loaded (other Mistral/coding models, embedding models, vision models -> operator focus)
GET /api/show {name:devstral} -> model details, template, system prompt, parameter file (operator customizations / leaked context)
GET /api/version (Ollama) -> CVE matching against Probllama family (CVE-2024-37032/39719/39720/39721/39722)
GET /v1/models (vLLM) -> exact checkpoint id; cross-ref with vLLM CVE family (CVE-2024-9052, CVE-2025-29770, CVE-2025-32444, CVE-2025-46570, GHSA-w6q7-j642-7c25)
GET /props (llama.cpp) -> model file path, context size, build commit
Same-/32 shadow-port sweep -> Tabby/OpenHands/Continue/Cody co-deployed coding-agent UI (Insight #12 IP-direct-shadow)
Same-/24 sweep -> operator-owned cluster of inference stacks (11434, 8000, 8080, 1234, 30000)
vulnerabilities: CVE-2024-37032 Probllama (Ollama <0.1.34 RCE) — if serving stack is Ollama, version check is the primary CVE gate
CVE-2024-39719/39720/39721/39722 Ollama (file-existence oracle, DoS, path traversal)
Devstral itself: model weights Apache 2.0 / Modified MIT, no model-specific CVE — risk surface is 100% in the serving stack
